name: Beetroot juice
description: Deep red pressed beetroot, earthy and very sweet.

ayurveda.note: Ushna and building; a blood-building juice in desi usage.

histamine.note: Low, though beetroot is high in oxalate and nitrate — separate matters.

effects.note: Dietary nitrate converts in the body to nitric oxide, a natural blood-vessel relaxant, and meta-analyses of RCTs find beetroot juice lowers systolic blood pressure by several mmHg, with no sign of the effect fading over weeks of daily use. A standard juice shot (70-250ml) sits within the range the trials use. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
